post-training:cafa.title: Scoring What Matters: Exact Feedback Reduction for Language Model Comparison
author_organizations: University of Electronic Science and Technology of China
post-training:cafa.code_status: 作者公开仓库存在，HEAD仅README并写明Coming soon；论文supplement声称代码包，但本轮未取得可核方法源码，不能标源码已发布。
post-training:cafa.summary: 按固定bank的精确评分identity聚合线性报告系数，分别规划mean与mean+ordinary covariance支持，超越普通缓存且保持同bank统计量。
post-training:cafa.fidelity_note: CPU实现Eq2–4与Algorithm2：Fraction精确系数、完整draw分母、版本cache、缺失反馈incomplete/mean bounds、分层均值协方差；不生成模型响应/Independent Star，不调用真实judge，不实测API节费。
post-training:cafa.local_command: PYTHONPATH=src python -c 'from auto_research.post_training.cafa import diagnostic; print(diagnostic(42))'

cost_assessment.basis: 完整实验含1.5B/1.7B、三GRPO轨迹、多sampler/budget/repeat、128prompt与付费版本judge；作者campaign保留223.04卡时包括训练、恢复和多类研究，非单次部署。完整矩阵超单A100/A30或Mac本轮短预算；小bank精确核可CPU执行。
cost_assessment.available_resource: one A100 or A30, or local Mac; CPU-only component
cost_assessment.decision: 成本过高，不复现（审查 DONE）；仅固定bank数学组件，完整矩阵终态。

post-training:elpsd.title: The Teacher Is Already Inside: Self-Distilling Looped Language Models Beyond Their Last Loop
post-training:elpsd.affiliation_evidence: Fixed-v1 PDF first page and HTML list sole author Linghua Zhang without institution; do not infer Independent Researcher or model-provider affiliation.
post-training:elpsd.code_status: 固定v1正文/摘要及有界标题作者检索未找到本方法公开源码链接；Ouro/vLLM依赖不是ELPSD方法源码。
post-training:elpsd.summary: 冻结初始模型第一/最后轮log分布外推全词表teacher，学生最后轮在自身prefix上精确reverse-KL；保持标准解码，不读取参考答案。
post-training:elpsd.fidelity_note: 给定logits的CPU Eq3–5精确teacher、response-balanced reverse KL/解析梯度、mask与理想化refreshed-target负控。没有循环Transformer、hidden-state提取、teacher模型拷贝、on-policy采样或训练，随机logits不冒充loop读数。
post-training:elpsd.local_command: PYTHONPATH=src python -c 'from auto_research.post_training.elpsd import diagnostic; print(diagnostic(42))'

cost_assessment.basis: Ouro-1.4B-Thinking全参、24层×4loops、14684题；100×64×8=51200响应槽，最长16384token，多训练对照/五benchmark×8eval；每卡冻结float32副本，单节点8GPU，型号/小时未披露。配置计数非本地实测，完整矩阵超单A100/A30或Mac短预算。
cost_assessment.available_resource: one A100 or A30, or local Mac; CPU-only component
cost_assessment.decision: 成本过高，不复现（审查 DONE）；仅给定logits数学核，完整矩阵终态。
